'''Fen Inor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who operated during the [[third Galactic War]] on [[Mek-Sha]]. Being an exile from his people, Inor was a member of the [[Dar'manda]], a group of gunrunners and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] comprised of former Mandalorians and other outlaws.<ref name="TOR:CUtS" />
